body:
## Problem
The trusted workflow checks out an arbitrary PR base that may not contain its classifier. The tooling PR fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The classifier documents main-target PRs, and active ruleset 21580900 applies its required context only to main.

## Proposed correction
Add exactly one workflow line: branches: [main] under pull_request_target. Preserve all existing jobs, permissions, event types, trusted base checkout, Action pins, classifier/integrity code, candidate bindings and failure semantics. No successful context is fabricated for other bases. Repository rules/settings are not changed.

## Identity
BASE_SHA=22665d7fa9274dfc05de043c8e9663e24e75087e
BASE_TREE=6981c1124524895273fb09b53d769ca9dbb722bc
RESULT_SHA=de2f5c0fd055e418d0b6d806f994b52baa743544
RESULT_TREE=1b443a620670216968b95cc43de96397550c24f2
BRANCH=fix/multi-trusted-base-scope-20260905
CHANGED_PATHS=.github/workflows/trusted-phase2d-freeze.yml; .github/trusted/phase2d-corrective4-baseline.json; docs/TRUSTED_BASE_SCOPE_CORRECTIVE_20260905.md

Separate governance corrective, not the format or agent-instruction checkpoint. Created through GitHub Git Data API from the exact main tree; no full local main checkout is claimed. No frozen or existing governance branch advanced.

## Validation and limitations
YAML parsed locally with PyYAML. Jobs/permissions/concurrency/event types compare equal; only the target-base filter is added. Existing classifier and live ruleset read independently. Local Node v24.19.0/npm 11.9.0; no pinned install, full governance/runtime test suite, build, dry-run, or actual new trigger dispatch claimed. Inaccessible legacy protection is not certified absent; adoption should confirm no additional non-main requirement. See committed note for full evidence and base cases.

This change does not affect running pull_request_target workflows until independently approved and merged. Keep this PR Draft; do not merge automatically. Current red tooling gate therefore remains expected.

No runtime or dependency changes, new phase, real/testnet credentials, exchange access/writes, settings changes, force-push, deployment or merge. No PASS/ACCEPT/merge/live decision.

## Current-SHA corrective verification
The first governance self-test (33964968438) completed 78 tests, then correctly rejected stale workflow inventory hashes. Follow-up refreshed only that workflow's blobSha and SHA-256 in trustedGovernanceFiles; all candidate identities, protectedFile rows, rules and other inventory rows compare unchanged. Values independently calculated from actual workflow bytes matched the generator's exact diff. This is an inventory refresh, not a runtime/candidate rebind.

At de2f5c0fd055e418d0b6d806f994b52baa743544: ordinary CI runs 33965123844 and 33965120390, trusted-governance-self-test 33965123861 (including generator idempotence), and trusted gate 33965121413 all completed successfully. These are CI observations, not approval of the governance change. Main and existing governance/runtime refs remain unchanged; non-main trigger behavior cannot take effect until separately reviewed integration.
title: fix(governance): restrict Phase 2D trusted trigger to supported main base
